 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Victor Wembanyama and the San Antonio Spurs host Darius Garland and the Los Angeles Clippers on Thursday during the 2026-27 NBA regular season.
 San Antonio saw its 12-game winning streak snapped Tuesday in a 105-93 loss to Cade Cunningham and the Detroit Pistons. Center Victor Wembanyama, who leads the team in scoring at 28.4 points per game, scored a team-high 25 points while securing a game-high 18 rebounds. Guard De'Aaron Fox leads the team with 5.5 assists per game.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Clippers vs Spurs TV Channels and Live Stream Options
 San Antonio Spurs Victor Wembanyama (1)Brad Penner-Imagn Images
 Time: 8 p.m. ET
 Venue: Frost Bank Center, San Antonio
 TV: DirecTV, NBA League Pass, ClipperVision, DAZN SAS, WB Los Angeles
 Live stream: NBA League Pass through Amazon Prime Video
 Fans can watch the game for free through various avenues. One option is Amazon Prime, where users can sign up for a seven-day free trial of NBA League Pass. Another option is DraftKings Sportsbook, which offers a three-month free trial. Users must submit a minimum deposit of $5. Another way for fans to watch for free is through DirecTV. Users can subscribe to DirecTV with a free-trial subscription that can be canceled within five days.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Los Angeles is sitting at 4-9 entering the game, having most recently lost to the Utah Jazz 132-107 on Tuesday. Guard Darius Garland leads the team in scoring at 21.2 points per game and in assists at 6.9 per game. Forward Rui Hachimura leads the team in rebounds at 5.9 per game.
 For Los Angeles, forward Brandon Ingram (Achilles), guard Bradley Beal (knee) and guard Jordan Miller (shoulder) are all out for the game. For San Antonio, guard Dylan Harper (hip), forward Tobias Harris (calf) and forward Jayden Quaintance (knee) are all out for the game.
